HRA Analysis: OVERVIEW: What a brilliant race this is to kick off the meeting at Kilmore. THE ART OF SUCCESS (9) is one of the most exciting mares in the country and she is aiming up for her ninth straight victory here. Most of her wins have come from in front, so her barrier makes for her to adopt a different racing pattern here. But regardless, she is a star and a horse to watch in the Vicbred Super Series Final next weekend. HOUSE PARTY (10) is the new mare on the scene. She’s a big horse and has been given time to develop. She hasn’t been seen since her dominant victory in the Encipher Stakes in October last year. She has only had the two career starts and we will learn more about her here. Fitness is a query. MIKI MOO (2) is a quality mare trained and driven by top NSW participant Luke McCarthy. She has spent most of her career racing in Brisbane. Her own sectional times aren’t far off the big guns in this field and she gets an ideal barrier. WICKED CONFESSION (8), the inaugural Running Of The Bulls winner, is all class and she’s won her two starts back this campaign in style, but she will need to overcome a sticky barrier. Also respecting Ladies In Red’s sister LUV THE NITELIFE (7) as well as PEACE OUT (11) in this event. BACK: R1 #9 THE ART OF SUCCESS into R3 #4 THE LAST TRIP – 3 units (win multi) SELECTIONS:THE ART OF SUCCESS (9), HOUSE PARTY (10), MIKI MOO (2), WICKED CONFESSION (8)

OVERVIEW: LET HER ROLL (5) is a talented mare. She has only raced three times this year, but as a juvenile she was one of the leading fillies in her age group. In her last start, the mile rate was 1.51.9 and she finished fifth but had to cover an extra 35 metres, racing wide from her tough barrier. Her class is there, but her barrier may be tricky with talented mares to her inside. SOAP AND BUBBLES (3) is a fast mare with terrific gate speed. She has the talented SOHO AMERICANO (2) drawn to her inside, but she may still try to cross early. If she can find the fence here, she looks a great chance. SHES ALLABOUTLUV (9) has been a dominant force in the Tasmanian ranks over the last year. She’s won 10 of 14 starts this season. She was run down by WICKED CONFESSION in a recent Kilmore trial. She is a quality mare, but this looks to be one of her toughest asks to date. SOHO AMERICANO (2) has been a star in her age group, racing her whole career. She won the QLD and VIC Oaks last year at the top level. She is a versatile mare but seems to be performing a little below her best. The good barrier here suits her well. Also, MISS ARI (8) is a runner that can’t be left out here with her brilliant turn of foot. SELECTIONS: LET HER ROLL (5), SOAP AND BUBBLES (3), SHES ALLABOUTLUV (9), SOHO AMERICANO (2)

OVERVIEW: THE LAST TRIP (4) couldn’t be more impressive in his four runs since returning to the racetrack this year. All four runs have been dominant victories with a combined winning margin of 90.9. Wow! This field is full of class and looks his toughest test. CIGANO (8) has only had the two starts this year and is first up since July. He’s a talented performer who is versatile and can be driven for his speed or strength, but he has an awkward barrier here and will need luck. SCHWARZ (5) has been unbeaten in his five runs this year, the most recent four all being in Tasmania. He’s in flying form, but this is harder. SAO PAULO SIMBA (9) won four of his last five starts at Menangle before going amiss last start. He’s raced at the top level his whole career and will get a good trip here from barrier nine to be flashing home late. COASTAL DRIVE (2), FORTY LOVE (3), FIRE MARSHALL (1) and STORMS COLLIDE (7) are all talented horses as well that can’t be left out here and look first four hopes. BACK: R1 #9 THE ART OF SUCCESS into R3 #4 THE LAST TRIP – 3 units (win multi) SELECTIONS:THE LAST TRIP (4), CIGANO (8), SCHWARZ (5), SAO PAULO SIMBA (9)

OVERVIEW: FOX DAN (1) is last year’s Victoria Derby winner and Eureka runner-up. This is a quality field, but barrier one really helps the star four-year-old here. FAIRPLAY (5) is in fantastic form, winning his four starts this year impressively. He may look to work forward here, but regardless, he’s one of the standout performers in this field. HESITATE (3) has brilliant point-to-point speed. If he gets a comfortable trip here, he will be storming to the line late. NEW SHUFFLE (9) will get a good trip here from barrier nine without having to be used up early. He looks a good first four hope. Also respecting APOLLOSTORM (10), HITCH TO HIS STAR (8) and CALEXICO (2) in this event. BACK: R4 #1 FOX DAN into R5 #8 I AM THE STORM – 3 units(win multi) SELECTIONS:FOX DAN (1), FAIRPLAY (5), HESITATE (3), NEW SHUFFLE (9).

OVERVIEW: This looks to be another great race full of quality talent. I AM THE STORM (8) was brave last start, sitting in the breeze at Melton and still prevailing to be too strong. However, that was not surprising as he’s a talented horse that seems to have reached new heights this year. The barrier is awkward for him here. ITS CONFIDENTIAL (4) has not been performing poorly recently by any means, but he’s been a little bit out of form numerically. He suits races run at an even tempo where the last quarter isn’t super quick. Recently, all his runs have had a final quarter that has probably been a bit quick for him from well back in the field to make up ground. He was the winner of this series as a three-year-old and is absolutely proven at this level. He’s a talented horse. PICK UP ELVIS (9) has been super in his last two runs behind THE LAST TRIP. Two starts ago, he flashed home from last and wasn’t far behind the star four-year-old. He should get a good trip here. SEATHESTARS (3) is first up here, but he was eye-catching beating a nice field of horses in a recent Melton trial. He has raced at the top level his whole career and he should be able to map well here from barrier three. An interesting horse to note in this field is MCMAYHEM (5). He has done all his racing in Tasmania and is first up here for Mitchell Frost. BACK: R4 #1 FOX DAN into R5 #8 I AM THE STORM – 3 units(win multi) SELECTIONS:I AM THE STORM (8), ITS CONFIDENTIAL (4), PICK UP ELVIS (9), SEATHESTARS (3).

OVERVIEW: SHEER ME (4) has had two starts since moving to Victoria for two fourths. He was checked and got well back in his first run at Ararat but hit the line well. Last start, he did it tough at Shepparton, racing in the breeze, but still ran home well and was only beaten 4.2 metres. He gets his chance here. DYGANALI (8) ran home well for third two starts back and led last start to narrowly get beaten late. If it can get some luck here from the barrier, it’s one of the winning chances in this field. PARINI (5) is a lightly raced performer from the Stephen O'Donoghue stable. He is first up since July and has been trialling OK. He could be an improver. MY MATE ACE (7) is first up since last year. Fitness may be a query from the barrier, but he was a consistent performer last year and didn’t look far off winning his maiden. Noting JAMALA KHAN (2) is first up here for trainer Malcolm Bull. BAC: SHEER ME (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:SHEER ME (4), DYGANALI (8), PARINI (5), MY MATE ACE (7)

OVERVIEW: Trainer Brad Angove has a good hand in this race with AFRICAN GALA (4) and BROOKLYNGOTCOURAGE (1). AFRICAN GALA (4) comes out of a heat in the Vicbred Super Series won by Munny The Munster. He finished seventh here but certainly didn’t disgrace himself. This is an easier race and he looks well placed. BROOKLYNGOTCOURAGE (1) backs up from a third at Maryborough on Monday when she ran home well. She has barrier one here and should get a good trip. BUCKLES FOR BERRY (3) was a good second at Ballarat last start behind Dreams Of Love. She is starting to figure out what racing is all about and is performing confidently. She has a good turn of foot. SPANISH RIZARDO (5) was racing well last preparation and is first up here. Fitness is a query, especially from the awkward barrier. SELECTIONS:AFRICAN GALA (4), BROOKLYNGOTCOURAGE (1), BUCKLES FOR BERRY (3), SPANISH RIZARDO (5)

OVERVIEW: JESSICAS STORY (7) is stepping out here for the 200th time. She had a tough run last start but still hit the line really well for third. Barrier seven isn’t ideal, but she can make her own luck. FLING IT RAINBOW (2) won two starts ago when leading early and taking a sit to get a perfect fence trip. He may adopt similar tactics here. The flashy grey KALARNEY PRINCE (1) has been racing OK this preparation and will get a good fence trip here. ALDEBARAN MARCUS (6) is a contender here if he finds some luck. BACK: JESSICAS STORY (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: JESSICAS STORY (7), FLING IT RAINBOW (2), KALARNEY PRINCE (1), ALDEBARAN MARCUS (6)

OVERVIEW: This is a very competitive event to end the meeting. MASSIF CENTRAL (6)’s usual racing tactic is to use his early speed to find the fence. He will look to adopt similar tactics here. I prefer him over the shorter trip which he has here. BET BET HOTSHOT (1) has been out of form recently but gets the chance to turn it around here with the perfect fence trip. MACHO MAORI (2) will need to bring his best here, but he has been racing well for his grade and is a first four chance here. LITTLE TEDEY (8) can get it wrong with his manners, but being the only horse on the back row, he has time and space to settle early. At his best, he is a winning chance. SELECTIONS: MASSIF CENTRAL (6), BET BET HOTSHOT (1), MACHO MAORI (2), MOONSHINE LOUIE (7) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:SHES POPPY (3) began quickly to find the lead, backed off the tempo mid-race and sprinted home too well to win with something in reserve last week. This race is slightly tougher but she is likely to use her gate speed to find a prominent position again and should prove hard to beat. CHEERS POVERTY (5) was beaten by a long way last week but this is a significant drop back in class and his form prior was sound. He is a fast beginner and should give a forward showing. YARRAMAN JOLT (7) worked early to lead, took cover and tired badly at the end when last of nine at Melton on August 29. The mile rate was a slick 1.53.2 and he won easily at his only start at Mildura previously so he is worth another chance. STARVIN MARVIN (4) was also beaten by a considerable margin last week but he has won two of his past five starts at Mildura so he is capable of a better performance here. BACK: SHES POPPY – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: SHES POPPY (3), CHEERS POVERTY (5), YARRAMAN JOLT (7), STARVIN MARVIN (4)

OVERVIEW:FLAME BLASTER (3) began quickly to trail the leader from a similar draw when he had no luck in gaining a clear run over the latter stages and finished an unlucky third behind She’s Poppy last week. He was a winner at Mildura three starts ago and this is a race of similar standard so he is worth an investment. WATCH THE ATTITUDE (7) led throughout and scored by a big margin in a sizzling mile rate of 1.56.5 on August 07. She hasn’t performed as well in three starts since and is unlikely to find the lead from the inside of the second line but she has the ability to show up if she can return to her peak. RUBBLEONTHEDOUBLE (6) appeared to have every chance in the one out and one back trail when fourth behind She’s Poppy last week. He was placed at his four attempts prior, including a Mildura victory, and is worth another chance. YELLA (1) is racing outside of his class range but he wasn’t beaten by far at his return to trainer Julie Douglas at Wagga and is drawn to receive every chance so he is not to be underestimated. SELECTIONS: FLAME BLASTER (3), WATCH THE ATTITUDE (7), RUBBLEONTHEDOUBLE (6), YELLA (1)

OVERVIEW: ACCELERE (4) has been placed in all of his three starts since returning from Queensland and deserves to break through for a win. He attempted to lead throughout and was run down late when second behind Always On Safari last week. MEGAWATTS (7) is awkwardly drawn but appears to be well placed against this line up. She won at her only start on this track previously and her recent efforts have been against stronger opposition so she should be working home well. SUNSHINE WARRIOR (2) began quickly to find the lead and scored comfortably at Mildura last week. His wins are well spaced but he is drawn to obtain a prominent position again and is not without a chance. BOHEMIAN BRAIDS (1), RED HOT MIKI (6) and SNEAKY PHILTRA (9) are all worth thought in an open race. BACK: ACCELERE (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: ACCELERE (4), MEGAWATTS (7), SUNSHINE WARRIOR (2), BOHEMIAN BRAIDS (1)

OVERVIEW: KEAYANG CRIPPA (9) raced without cover throughout and dashed well clear to win easily two starts ago then followed with a handy finishing third last week. He is a versatile pacer and looms as one of the leading chances again. LORD VERDE (6) settled four back on the markers, was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off fast for an eye-catching second at Globe Derby last week. He is poorly drawn but is racing too well to dismiss. FLEUR BELLA (4) settled midfield and finished off nicely at Mildura last week. She has done well in two starts since coming from New South Wales and is worth an investment. LOVE TO DEAL (5) worked hard to hold the lead around the first turn, eventually took cover at the 1300m and battled on fairly well for fourth behind Seaside Lady at Globe Derby. She has performed well at Mildura previously and should give a forward showing. BACK: KEAYANG CRIPPA – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: KEAYANG CRIPPA (9), LORD VERDE (6), FLEUR BELLA (4), LOVE TO DEAL (5)

OVERVIEW:CAPTIVATE ME (8) began quickly to lead, copped some pressure in the early stages and kicked on well for second behind Jades Reason last week. He has been runner up at his past four starts at Mildura and deserves to break through for a win. OZZIE DIAMOND (3) is a juvenile taking on older horses and hasn’t looked like running a place at her five starts to date but her latest fifth behind the top filly Ideal Frankie in a heat of the Super Series was encouraging. This race is much easier and a better showing is expected. PRETTY MISCHIEVOUS (5) gained the perfect trip and appeared to have every chance when third at Globe Derby last outing. This race might be a little more suitable and she has been placed four times from limited opportunities for the season so she warrants consideration. SWEET LUCY LOU (2) will appreciate her best draw for some time and her past two efforts have been good enough to figure in the finish under these conditions. SELECTIONS: CAPTIVATE ME (8), OZZIE DIAMOND (3), PRETTY MISCHIEVOUS (5), SWEET LUCY LOU (2)

OVERVIEW:KING SAINT (6) has impressed at Mildura having had two wins and a placed effort from just four attempts and he wasn’t beaten by far in a slick mile rate of 1.53.4 at Metropolitan level last week. He is widely drawn but should make his presence felt. EARL OF PEMBROKE (10) has been safely held at his three starts since resuming but he was picking up late ground when fifth at Wagga last week and he should be reaching his peak fitness. BIZZNESS CLASS (5) settled down in a rearward position and was extremely wide on the home turn when a fast finishing third at Mildura last week. He has been placed in two of his past three starts against similar opposition and should be finding the line strongly again. GOOD BOOTS BINDI (1) is stepping up in class but she is perfectly drawn to suit her racing pattern and is worth a ticket each way. LETSGO BIG GIRL (4) is racing in good form but tends to perform best over the sprint distance and KEAYANG MOROCCAN (7) was unlucky last week after being held up behind tiring horses before the home turn and finishing off nicely. BACK: KING SAINT (6) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: KING SAINT (6), EARL OF PEMBROKE (10), BIZZNESS CLASS (5), GOOD BOOTS BINDI (1)

OVERVIEW: FROSTY DROP (1) was unlucky at her last start at Kilmore in the Vicbred Super Series heat won by Bettor Beach. She restrained to last and ran home well but couldn’t make up much ground in a 26.7 quarter. So although she finished last, it wasn’t a bad run. She has the ace barrier here and enough gate speed to lead. She should be hard to beat. COOL STORY (9) was quirky last start, hanging and racing a bit greenly. He got well back but was still able to run home well for sixth. His runs prior were consistent. He should map well. ANIMADO (4) is second-up here and will improve with fitness from his first-up fifth at Shepparton last week. In that run, he settled second-last and ran home well. POSTERIZED (10) is a smart performer but has to overcome a sticky barrier here. Also respecting the emergency JUST PEDRO (11), who will be a winning chance if he gains a start in this event. SELECTIONS:FROSTY DROP (1), COOL STORY (9), ANIMADO (4), POSTERIZED (10).

OVERVIEW: BLUE MIKI (1) has not drawn barrier one since March 2025. He has been racing well and should have enough gate speed to hold a forward position here. PRECIOUS BELLE (8) will be the horse on his back and she is racing well. She has a nice turn of foot and will get the run of the race. ALLHEARTNOHEIGHT (4) has won twice at this track in his last four starts. He was held up until late last start at Kilmore but ran home really well. MIDNIGHT MOJO (6) will be hoping to slot into a good position here from the awkward barrier, but if he does, expect him to be running home well late. Also respecting TED BEAR (10) and the emergency LORIMERMAJOR (7) if he gains a start. It’s his 200th start and he is second-up. BACK: BLUE MIKI (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:BLUE MIKI (1), PRECIOUS BELLE (8), ALLHEARTNOHEIGHT (4), MIDNIGHT MOJO (6).

OVERVIEW: This is an interesting race full of inexperienced performers. INDULGEME (4) is a brilliantly bred colt who trialled well before his debut last week. Unfortunately, he got it wrong with his manners in his race attempt. If he gets it right here, he will be hard to beat. LACE AND LEATHER (3) is an Art Major-sired debutant who was second in an Echuca trial behind Ozzie Diamond. We will learn more about him here. COCO MILLER (10) is similar to INDULGEME (4). She is a well-bred filly with great trial form who got it wrong with her manners on debut. She gets another chance here but from a sticky barrier. ARZALI SHACARRI (2) was beaten 10 metres behind Letitrideluv in a Geelong trial. Letitrideluv went on to compete very well in the Vicbred Super Series Semi-Final. The other debutants in this field, we will learn more about here but they deserve respect, AMANDO (1), EDGAR BROMAC (5) and SIR KITT (8). BACK: INDULGEME (4)– 4 units (win) SELECTIONS:INDULGEME (4), LACE AND LEATHER (3), COCO MILLER (10), ARZALI SHACARRI (2)

OVERVIEW: What a cracking race this is. JILLIBY DREAMLOVER (9), the star mare, is back in action in Victoria. She won the Group 1 The Great Square at Albion Park three starts ago, then competed in the Inter Dominion last start but was unfortunately checked. She’s achieved so much already in her career. She has some tough opposition here, which could make her vulnerable first-up. But she is a classy horse. GATESYS GEM (3) is one of the best young trotters in the country and she can make her own luck. She won the NSW Oaks and Derby double last year and at her best is very hard to beat. She will likely look to find the fence here. But there is a gate speed threat from the horse drawn to her outside, KEAYANG KURKI (4). KEAYANG KURKI (4) was the winner of the Breeders Crown last year. She also won the Vicbred Super Series Final as a two-year-old. Without a doubt, she has ability, but she hasn’t won this year. She can fly the gate, but she will need to find her best form to beat the two top mares in this field. NO MONEY NO HONEY (2) is an interesting horse. When she trots, she is a very talented type. However, her manners are a massive query. She did everything right when winning her last start in July. SELECTIONS:JILLIBY DREAMLOVER (9), KEAYANG KURKI (4), GATESYS GEM (3), NO MONEY NO HONEY (2)

OVERVIEW: I AM WILMA (4) returned a winner last start impressively. She was the winner of this series as a three-year-old. She is always consistently running strong races and she’s one of the winning chances for the final next Saturday night. SKYBELLA (3) is a smart trotting mare when she is at her best. Two starts ago, she won at Melton, and then last start she got well back but ran home well. She does appear to be performing a little below her best, but even if she’s not at her best, she’s still one of the top mares in this age group. CALABASAS (7) is still figuring out what racing is all about, but if she gets a good run, I expect her to be running home well. ALDEBARAN SUE (10), LITTLE MISS VALLEY (8) and PROHIBITED GRACE (5) are quality mares, but they will need to overcome sticky barriers. SELECTIONS:I AM WILMA (4), SKYBELLA (3), CALABASAS (7), ALDEBARAN SUE (10)

OVERVIEW: I AM HELLBOUND (3) is currently one of the best young trotters in New South Wales, trained by Scott Hewitt. He has got better with age. He rarely puts in a bad run and gets a good barrier here. MUSKEE (6) is a progressive, talented trotter for John and Ewa Justice. He won really impressively at Melton three starts ago. He will need to bring his best. CLAUDYS HERO (4) is second-up here and will improve with fitness from his first-up fifth at Melton, where he got well back but hit the line really well. He is a versatile type. ALDEBARAN ABEL (8) is a smart trotter that can make his own luck, but he has a challenging barrier here. Also strongly respecting ZARSKI (5) and KARBINE (7) here. SELECTIONS:I AM HELLBOUND (3), MUSKEE (6), CLAUDYS HERO (4), ALDEBARAN ABEL (8)

OVERVIEW: This is another brilliant race full of talent. ALRIGHTY (2) is a trotter who has found new heights this year. He runs in the famous Maori’s Idol colours. His three recent starts and wins have a cumulative 44.4-metre winning margin. He should be able to map well here from barrier two and will be hard to catch. IJUSTCALLEDTOSAY (9) is a talented trotter who can sometimes get his manners wrong. Barrier nine suits as he has time and space to settle here. He looks the main rival to ALRIGHTY (2). SAM NIEN (1) looks to be performing a little below his best, but he has great gate speed and will be able to map well here and get the run of the race. SKY SPIRIT (5) is a lightly raced trotter with a lot of ability. He was fourth when first-up here last start behind THE PREACHER. He will improve from that run with fitness. SELECTIONS:ALRIGHTY (2), IJUSTCALLEDTOSAY (9), SKY SPIRIT (5), SAM NIEN (1)

OVERVIEW: This race does look to be the toughest to figure out on this card, with a few of these horses out of form. ALPHA CRUCIS (8) is second-up after a first-up fourth when facing the breeze at Cranbourne. It was not a bad run, and expect improvement with fitness. The barrier makes it hard. DI ANGELO (2) hasn’t had much luck recently, but he hasn’t been performing poorly. With the barrier, he finds a race where he can change his form. ZWICK (10) does have winning form, taking out his last start at Terang. He led and won in this event, however, it was not in fast time, and he will need to overcome a sticky barrier here. SHEZABLUECHIP (3) has had some very tough runs recently. So she’s racing a bit better than her form looks on paper. Barrier three could help her change her form. GOODTIME MAE (7) has the best sectional times in this event but a sticky barrier. SELECTIONS:ALPHA CRUCIS (8), DI ANGELO (2), ZWICK (10), SHEZABLUECHIP (3)

OVERVIEW: JILLIBY TOPGUN (3) was second-up last start and ran a good second after having to do some work in the run. Third-up here, he will likely be back to his best. He is a smart horse and Lisa Pitt does a great job with her trotters. KAMARAN (5) has had a career-best season. He’s a tough horse that can make his own luck, however, he is first-up here and fitness could be a query. FRITSCH (4) is a smart trotter who raced at the top level of his age group throughout his juvenile races. He has only had the four starts this year, including one win. Last start, he was three fence but ran home well. DREAMS OF LOVE (1) regained her best form last start when leading and winning impressively. She gets the ace barrier here and has the gate speed to have options early. KEAYANG TWEETYBIRD (8) needs to trot but has the ability and high speed. BACK: JILLIBY TOPGUN (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:JILLIBY TOPGUN (3), KAMARAN (5), FRITSCH (4),DREAMS OF LOVE (1).

OVERVIEW: ELLEEGANT LANE (5) has been racing well and has the best sectional times in this event. The barrier is a concern. TASTE IT (3) was a winner first-up last start when she was able to find the front. She was strong to the line and should improve here second-up with fitness. SPUN SILVER (7) is a fast mare who is in great form. I do prefer her over the short trip, however, and the distance is a concern from her awkward barrier as she’s unlikely to find the fence early. FOUR EVER A STAR (4) could be an improver here second-up after being on the sidelines since 2023. I also have respect here for CINQUANTA (2) from the barrier. BACK: ELLEEGANT LANE (5) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:ELLEEGANT LANE (5), TASTE IT (3), SPUN SILVER (7), CINQUANTA (2) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

ROLL TO THE TOP (6) was shuffled back last time out and was running on strongly last time out behind My Ultimate Victor. She is likely to be shuffled back from a wide draw in this race and should be running on late. THE TIGER ARMY (3) doesn’t have a lot of gate speed but may be able to drive through and lead in this race. He was very good last time out when sitting without cover and running fourth behind TERRAGONG SWINGER (5). ULTIMATE ARK (9) should get a good run off the speed in this race which is seemingly how he runs his best races. He ran on nicely in a recent trial finishing second. TERRAGONG SWINGER (5) was able to show good gate speed to lead last time out and took them all the way there. He draws wider this time but if he could lead again he’d likely be hard to catch. SELECTIONS: ROLL TO THE TOP (6), THE TIGER ARMY (3), ULTIMATE ARK (9), TERRAGONG SWINGER (5) SUGGESTED BET: THE TIGER ARMY (3) to win.

STILLYOURSHOT (8) led last time out in a stronger race and was beaten there by Magic Jujon. He should get a good run through early in this race and should be close enough to figure. SHEZ A PUNTER (2) has good gate speed and might be able to work to the front in this race. She took on a strong race last time out at Albion Park and finished last but wasn’t beaten too far. MOVE HEAVENNEARTH (1) doesn’t have a lot of gate speed which is likely to see her shuffled back a touch early. She was good running fifth last time out and can run well with a similar effort in this race. MAHINDI (6) wasn’t suited last time out when drawing poorly outside the front row at this track. She finds a slightly weaker race and with the right run could figure. SELECTIONS: STILLYOURSHOT (8), SHEZ A PUNTER (2), MOVE HEAVENNEARTH (1), MAHINDI (6) SUGGESTED BET: STILLYOURSHOT (8) to win.

BONNIES CAM (13) was shuffled a long way back last time out before running into fifth behind The Harris Hawk. He looks well suited in this field and should be running on late. KEAYANG TARA (3) made a break early last time out and was shuffled back as a result before running on late wide on the track. If she was able to step safely this time she should be thereabouts. ROSIES BOY (12) was forced to race without cover last time out and battled on fairly there to finish sixth not beaten too far. If he can settle close with cover this time he can be running on late. ROCKNROLL DA GAMA (1) appears well handicapped again in this race. He held a good position last time out at this track behind the leader before being dragged out of it at a crucial stage. SELECTIONS: BONNIES CAM (13), KEAYANG TARA (3), ROSIES BOY (12), ROCKNROLL DA GAMA (1) SUGGESTED BET: BONNIES CAM (13) to win.

JAY TEE TYRON (1) should be able to lead from the good draw in this race. He led last time out and set a strong tempo there in a race taken out by Tiger Tommy at this track. ROCKY LEIGH (7) should get a good run through early in this race. He was able to secure a good run recently at this track and was running on well into second behind Charlie Chuckles. DEEP REGRET (9) was able to work to the lead last time out and held off the late challenge of Playing For Keeps in that race. He draws to do no work in this race and should run well again. ONE CHAIN ROAD (3) led last time out in a similar type of run and was just run down late by War Club. He should settle close and can run well again. SELECTIONS: JAY TEE TYRON (1), ROCKY LEIGH (7), DEEP REGRET (9), ONE CHAIN ROAD (3) SUGGESTED BET: ROCKY LEIGH (7) to win.

HES ALL TORQUE (13) was a dominant winner of his heat last start when sweeping over the top to score. He comes into the final off a 40 metre handicap but clearly looks the one to beat again in this race. HES REGAL (7) was able to work into a nice position early last time out before tracking Our Sweet Jess into the race and finishing over the top late to beat Rocktime. He should get a similar run and should be running on late again. FOXFIRE EASTON (10) looked to have a big task ahead of him chasing down THE CASUAL GOOSE (3) last time out who was able get loose on the lead but he drove hard late and was able to pick him up right on the line. He is likely to get back again and can be running on late. THE CASUAL GOOSE (3) was able to step nicely to lead last time out setting a strong tempo and just being run down late by one of the key runners in the final FOXFIRE EASTON (10). If he can step to the lead again he can give them something to catch. SELECTIONS: HES ALL TORQUE (13), HES REGAL (7), FOXFIRE EASTON (10), THE CASUAL GOOSE (3) SUGGESTED BET: HES ALL TORQUE (13) to win.

MILLIONDOLLAR KISS (6) was forced to race without cover last time out and battled on strongly there for second behind Feelin Forastar who had a good run off the speed in that race. She draws wide and may be forced to do some work but is capable. CAPTAIN OH CAPTAIN (9) copped a lot of pressure early last time out and through the middle stages of the race and was just getting tired late when finishing fourth. He draws to do less work this time and can be running on late. PLAYING FOR KEEPS (5) took the sit behind the leader last time out and was running on well late into second behind Deep Regret. She looks well suited again in this race and should run well. PLAYFUL MISS (8) was able to secure a good run last time out at this track and was able to run into third there behind stablemate Feelin Forastar. She should get a good run and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: MILLIONDOLLAR KISS (6), CAPTAIN OH CAPTAIN (9), PLAYING FOR KEEPS (5), PLAYFUL MISS (8) SUGGESTED BET: MILLIONDOLLAR KISS (6) to win.

THATS CLASSIC (3) secured a good run off the speed last time out and was running on into third late behind Maywyn Valentino and PERFECT LOU (5). He draws well but hasn’t shown a huge amount of gate speed so far in his career which could be a query. SERENUS (8) showed good gate speed to zip across before taking a sit and running behind Usual Suspect. She draws to do no work early in this race and should be running on late. WICKED BERRIES (7) draws awkwardly inside the back row in this race. She had a tough run last time out and did well to battle on for second there behind Piccolo Diavolo. She should run well again. PERFECT LOU (5) secured a good run last time out at this track and was running on late into third behind Piccolo Diavolo. He draws wide but does have good early speed and may find a prominent position. SELECTIONS: THATS CLASSIC (3), SERENUS (8), WICKED BERRIES (7), PERFECT LOU (5) SUGGESTED BET: THATS CLASSIC (3) to win.

TWIN CITIES (3) wasn’t beaten far last time out in a much stronger race taken out by Crusey. She showed good gate speed there which should see her able to drive through and lead in this race. She is likely to be very hard to beat. MULLUM SIZZLE (6) secured a good run off the speed last time out and just couldn’t reel in Dixon debutant Gift Giver which impressed in her first start. He looks to face a tough draw this time and may need to do work at some stage. ADORE CINDY (7) secured a good run leaders back behind Dancinwithpleasure and was able to run second there. She appears likely to get a reasonable run on the pegs in this race and can be running on late. AIMEES ALIAS (1) drew poorly last time out at Marburg and was running on late into fourth behind Hez Our Playboy. She finds a tougher race here but does draw well. SELECTIONS: TWIN CITIES (3), MULLUM SIZZLE (6), ADORE CINDY (7), AIMEES ALIAS (1) SUGGESTED BET: TWIN CITIES (3) to win.
